spec.title: In Flight Commands
spec.description: Daml commands through the synchronous CommandService currently in flight

spec.title: Number of requests being validated
spec.description: Number of requests that are currently being validated. This also covers requests submitted by other participants.

spec.title: Health Status
spec.description: Status of the participant (healthy or not)

spec.title: Max Event Age
spec.description: Age of the oldest event age at hourly granularity

spec.title: Completed ACS Commitment Lag
spec.description: Lag behind the timestamp of when the last completed commitment interval was processed and the timestamp of the interval

spec.expr: min by (namespace, job, node) (timestamp(daml_participant_sync_commitments_tick_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}) - ((daml_participant_sync_commitments_tick_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} > 0) / 1e6))

spec.title: Commitment Checkpoint Lag
spec.description: Lag behind the timestamp the commitment checkpoint was created and the timestamp of the checkpoint; periodic lag spikes during commitment computation are expected

spec.expr: min by (namespace, job, node) ((timestamp(daml_participant_sync_commitments_checkpoint_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}) - ((daml_participant_sync_commitments_checkpoint_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} > 0) / 1e6)))
max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_participant_sync_commitments_digest_processor_health{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})
max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_participant_sync_commitments_matcher_health{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})
max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_participant_sync_commitments_tick_signaller_health{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})

spec.title: Parties
spec.description: This metric measures progress in the number of counterparties during the digest processor reinitialization. This metric is reset to 0 at the start of reinitialization.

spec.title: Contract Changes
spec.description: This metric measures the progress in the number of identified contract changes upon reinitializing the digests. This metric is reset to 0 at the start of reinitialization. Since the same contract may be processed multiple times (for different counterparties), this metric may exceed the number of active contracts.

spec.title: Tombstones
spec.description: This metric measures progress in the number of persisted tombstones during the digest processor reinitialization. This metric is reset to 0 at the start of reinitialization.

spec.title: ACS Commitment Sender Lag
spec.description: Lag behind wallclock time and the time of the commitment the sender was processing

spec.expr: min by (namespace, job, node) (timestamp(daml_participant_sync_commitments_sender_watermark_timestamp{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}) - ((daml_participant_sync_commitments_sender_watermark_timestamp{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} > 0) / 1e6))

spec.title: Last Sent ACS Commitment
spec.description: Timestamp of the latest sent ACS commitment

spec.title: Last Incoming Received ACS Commitment
spec.description: Timestamp of the latest incoming ACS commitment period end that has been received and enqueued, but not yet processed by the participant.

spec.title: Last Incoming Processed ACS Commitment
spec.description: Timestamp of the latest incoming ACS commitment period end that was fully processed by the participant.

spec.title: Last Locally Completed ACS Commitment
spec.description: Timestamp of the latest locally completed ACS commitment interval. Crash recovery will start reingesting from this timestamp on or from the latest checkpointed ACS commitment interval on, whichever is later.

spec.title: Last Locally Checkpointed ACS Commitment
spec.description: Timestamp of the latest checkpointed ACS commitment in microseconds. Crash recovery will start reingesting from this timestamp on or from the latest locally completed ACS commitment interval on, whichever is later.

spec.title: Incoming Received ACS Commitment Lag
spec.description: Lag behind the timestamp the commitment was received and the timestamp of the commitment

spec.expr: min by (namespace, job, node) (timestamp(daml_participant_sync_commitments_received_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}) - ((daml_participant_sync_commitments_received_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} > 0) / 1e6))

spec.title: Incoming Processed ACS Commitment Lag
spec.description: Lag behind the timestamp the commitment was processed and the timestamp of the commitment

spec.expr: min by (namespace, job, node) (timestamp(daml_participant_sync_commitments_matching_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}) - ((daml_participant_sync_commitments_matching_watermark{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} > 0) / 1e6))

spec.title: Command Submission Latency (p99)
spec.description: 99th percentile of the time it takes the participant to process a command submission

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (namespace, job, node) (rate(daml_participant_api_commands_submissions_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Command Submissions
spec.description: Rate of valid command submissions and of commands that failed interpretation

spec.title: Unsequenced In-Flight Submissions
spec.description: Submissions sent to the synchronizer that have not yet been sequenced. A persistently high value means submissions are stuck or timing out.

spec.title: Request Tracker Task Queue
spec.description: Number of tasks queued in the request tracker waiting for their sequencer timestamp to be reached

spec.title: Indexer Lag
spec.description: Wall-clock time minus the record time of the last update received by the indexer

spec.title: ACHS Lag
spec.description: Number of event sequential IDs the active contract history (ACHS) is behind the ledger end. Only shown for participants where ACHS is populated.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, node) (daml_participant_api_indexer_ledger_end_sequential_id{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} - (daml_participant_api_indexer_achs_valid_at{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"} > 0))

spec.title: ACHS Buffer Length
spec.description: Number of entries buffered by the indexer waiting to be written to the ACHS

spec.title: Pruning Duration
spec.description: Average and 99th percentile duration of participant pruning runs over the last hour

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (namespace, job, node) (increase(daml_pruning_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[1h])))
